hypothesis: The interaction of liquidity constraints and risk earns a premium: low-liquidity/high-volatility crypto contracts outperform high-liquidity/low-volatility contracts.
mechanism: The source reports that the strongest equal-weight interaction portfolios are driven by liquidity combined with volatility/risk, with profits concentrated where trading is difficult.
universe: All Binance USD-M USDT perpetual contracts whose first archive timestamp is no later than 2021-12-31; eligibility is point-in-time and requires trailing feature history. Delisted names remain in the historical universe until data end.
portfolio: long intersection of bottom-third trailing quote-volume and top-third realized volatility; short intersection of top-third quote-volume and bottom-third volatility; 0.5 gross each side
feature_lag: All trailing features end on the prior completed UTC day
holding: One week, Monday open to next Monday open; if a held contract ceases before next rebalance, mark to its last available close in the holding week.
fresh_confirmation: 2026 remains locked unless exploratory OOS success gate passes
development_gate: canonical net Sharpe >0.70, positive total return, and at least 2/3 volatility windows positive
success_gate: canonical exploratory OOS net Sharpe >1, positive at 2x costs, at least 2/3 windows positive, both 2024 and 2025 non-negative, DSR reported
